items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's what Lawrence Morrero told me. Who, Dink? [INTERVIEWEE] Ernest Johnson, Ernest Cuoco, Nene. Well, I don't know. That might have been for my time. Yeah, well, that's what he said. He played with him.

ctx.x: He's not there, he is. If I remember rightly, Dink told me that they used to tell him that he was their brother or cousin or something sometimes. Did he? Did he? Yeah. He wasn't related at all, but they'd tell people that. Sometime, you know, I don't know why. Yeah, I guess so.
Well, didn't he play with the superior? That's what Lawrence Morrero told me. Who, Dink?

Ernest Johnson, Ernest Cuoco, Nene. Well, I don't know. That might have been for my time. Yeah, well, that's what he said. He played with him. He played with him. Well, I went out in Los Angeles, I found him out there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, I found him. He had been out there a long time.
